title: Flight and Cabin Interphone — System Description

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew description of the interphone system, covering the call priorities between the flight deck, the cabin and the ground, and what the crew hears when a station cannot be reached.

sections.purpose: This entry describes the flight and cabin interphone as the flight crew uses it, including the call priorities and the indications that show a call has not been answered.
sections.description: The interphone carries three separate conversations that share one distribution: flight deck to cabin, cabin to cabin, and flight deck to ground. Calls are placed from the handset by selecting the station and pressing the call key, and the called station receives a chime and a light. Priority is fixed: a flight deck call takes precedence over a cabin to cabin call, and an emergency call takes precedence over both and is heard at every station simultaneously. The crew hears sidetone in the handset when transmitting, and the absence of sidetone is the first indication that the handset itself is not working rather than the far end. Where a station does not answer, the calling light stays on and no fault is raised; the system does not distinguish between a station that is unmanned and a station that is unserviceable, which is why a call that is never answered is not by itself a defect. Speech quality is not monitored and no indication is given for a degraded circuit.
sections.crew_procedure: Select the station on the handset, press the call key and wait for the answer. For an emergency call, use the EMER key, which overrides every other call in progress and is heard at all stations. If no sidetone is heard when transmitting, change to the other handset before reporting a system fault. Report a call that is readable in one direction only, or that carries a hum, in the technical log with the station and the phase of the flight, because that combination is what maintenance needs and is not recorded anywhere on the aircraft.

type_data.crew_action: Normal handset use; report a one-way or degraded call with the station and flight phase.
